name: design-excalidraw-tools
title: Excalidraw Diagram Designer
description: Design beautiful, readable Excalidraw diagrams of any kind, in six styles chosen from the request, from a Python generator, then lint, render, look and refine before delivery.
notes:
## What it does

Turns a request for a diagram into a beautiful Excalidraw scene: flows and processes, architectures, timelines and roadmaps, before/after comparisons, concept maps, layered stacks, posters with key figures, swimlanes and illustrated explainers with hand-drawn pictograms, in six styles chosen from the request and the audience: corporate (default), editorial, hand-drawn sketch, playful pastel, dark night and black-and-white mono. Colour is not the default; sober is. The diagram is generated from a short Python script built on a bundled kit, so it can be regenerated after every round of feedback.

## Quality loop

Message first, then structure, generate, lint, render, look, refine. The lint catches overflowing text, overlaps, arrows crossing labels, crowded boxes and colour sprawl; the render is always checked before delivery. Important diagrams get a cold critique from independent reviewers with distinct personas, and their findings are sorted, not blindly applied.

## Rendering and publishing

Renders locally with headless Chromium when available, or through the Excalidraw+ API (EXCALIDRAW_API_KEY, optional). New versions go to new scenes; scenes are never deleted or shared without an explicit request, because share links are public.

## Portability

Python helpers use only the standard library; the local renderer needs Node and Playwright, the publishing helper needs an Excalidraw+ API key. Without either, the skill still produces the .excalidraw file to open on excalidraw.com.

changes: Six named styles chosen from the request: corporate, editorial, sketch, playful, night, mono. Each is a full grammar (fonts for body, titles and labels; header; radius; quiet and key strokes; outlines; hachure zones; arched arrows; the loud element; colour mood), not only a palette.
Sober is the default; pastel only for playful; mono for print. New night and mono palettes, emphasis roles (loud, badge) so the strong block suits light and dark pages.
Liberation Sans, Cascadia and Lilita One width tables; style-aware Scene.header(); legend swatches match the drawing.

Dense process map example and recipe (lifecycle frame, two entrances, two tracks, gate checklist, skill badges, tools per step, loops, who-does-what, open questions), with banner, checklist, badge_legend, chip_stack and return_loop components.
Illustrated explainer recipe and example: pastel card per step, number badges, arched arrows, hand underline, takeaway in the accent.
doodles.py: 15 scalable pictograms (bubble, page, page stack, magnifier, check, cross, robot, person, database, bulb, clock, envelope, cloud, bars, answer with sources).
Playful palette and per-step tints; lint skips layout checks inside pictograms.
Initial package: design principles, recipes per diagram type, audience rules, review loop, Excalidraw+ publishing guide.
Bundled excalikit builder, lint_scene static checks, Excalidraw+ client and examples for each recipe.
Validated against baseline runs on three prompts: render-and-critique loop, data honesty (no invented units, illustrative examples marked), flow wrapping and card-height rules.

EXCALIDRAW_API_KEY.description: Optional Excalidraw+ API key used by scripts/excalidraw_plus.py to create scenes, push diagrams and take screenshots.
